purpose: Local functional check for a small transformer with separately near-matched CNN encoder/decoder parameter counts; no training approval.

data.augmentation: none in the first baseline; preserve palette and geometry
data.validation: fixed source-stratified blocks plus separately reported targeted coverage stress cases
data.reserved_test: exclude from development sampling, tuning and pilot evaluation
data.joining: only checked adjacent blocks within frozen sequences.json; never bridge a gap
data.training_inputs: Verified 128px NPZ clips from the bound v9 cohort, using checked sequences only

optimization.mixed_precision: FP16 with conservative initial scaling; requires a new GPU precision and resume measurement for changed code
optimization.schedule: 500-update linear warmup then cosine decay to 10% of stage peak; persist schedule and scaler in checkpoints
optimization.fallback: reduce microbatch and raise accumulation first; do not silently reduce resolution, change architecture or enlarge budget

departures: Encoder2 blocks width96 heads3; decoder3 blocks width64 heads2; much smaller than original Table7
512 codes of dimension64; Table7 uses1024 codes dimension32
existing reconstruction objective, optimizer and limited-prefix VQ initialization retained
learned spatial/temporal positions and pre-LN are local choices; paper not specific

constraints: CPU local preflight only; no allocation or training authorization
16 observed frames at10FPS, finite window memory; cold starts supported
real held-out quality and geometry unmeasured
representative codebook initialization requires separate training design before any larger run

comparison_design.codebook: 512 only preserves the current functional-check interface; actual step2 codebook choice remains dependent on step1 and is not selected here
comparison_design.capacity_limit: Matching parameter totals does not match useful capacity: transformer counts include learned position tables and global spatial/past-frame attention
comparison_design.work_limit: Matrix/convolution arithmetic estimate only, not a measured GPU cost
